data.title: Head of Engineering - Evian
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE At Danone, our commitment to manufacturing the highest quality products and meeting market demand is a fundamental driver for our plant teams. We are currently seeking an SeniorEngineering Manager for our Evian Fcaility. In this role, you will join the plant leadership team and be responsible for supporting all strategic, operational, and policy-related aspects of the plant, with a focus on safety, quality, performance, management, and organizational objectives. You will act as the primary point of contact for all capital projects within the plant, overseeing technical execution, timeline management, and financial oversight for each project. The Danone Evian site, located in Haute-Savoie on the shores of Lake Geneva, is globally recognized for its production of natural mineral water. For over 230 years, Evian water—resulting from a 15-year journey through the glacial rocks of the French Alps—has stood out for its purity and unique taste. The Evian site is a model of innovation and sustainability, with initiatives such as the use of 100% recycled and recyclable plastic bottles, and the protection of the local environment through the Association for the Protection of the Evian Mineral Water Impluvium (APIEME). With more than 300 quality tests carried out every day, the site guarantees exceptional water while committing to a sustainable future. It employs around 1,200 people across a wide range of roles, from bottling and water resource quality to environmental management, as well as safety and logistics. Job Responsibilities: Project execution for all current Processing, Packaging, Building and Utility projects Work with cross functional plant leadership team to align on project priorities Create technical specifications, preliminary budgets and project justification for new projects Work with CAPEX analyst and plant controller to manage the plant’s capital forecast and budget Coordinate and lead multi-functional teams (several engineering project managers and project engineers) Create, design and evaluate initial call for tender documents Work with Regional Engineering teams during bidding processes and technical alignment Work with the CAPEX procurement team to align on priorities and contract negotiations Edit and advise and implement Danone’s Standards Serve as a technical and leadership resource for Danone initiatives Build capabilities within engineering team Occasional project specific travel required Work with cross functional team to develop and update site masterplan Manage plant engineering team (several engineering project managers and project engineers) A PROPOS DE VOUS Job Qualifications: Experience and working knowledge in: Integrated automation and controls technology High speed packaging systems design Manufacturing plant utility systems Must be organized and self-disciplined to accommodate the management of concurrent projects Excellent conflict resolution and interpersonal skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work flexible hours, including weekend or late shifts, during installation/startup periods Experience and Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering, Science or relevant degree from an accredited College or University 8 to 10 years of experience 5 years of relevant Engineering experience required, preferably in CPG beverage/food manufacturing Previous people management experience required A PROPOS DE NOUS We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunity within our teams. data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Danone France ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais meilleure pour le monde ! C’est pour cela que nos 26 marques en France sont certifiées B Corp TM. * B Corp est la boussole de notre stratégie RSE ! Au sein de la direction commerciale, votre CVR vous accompagnera pour vous développer sur vos principales missions qui seront les suivantes : Le CCR Grands Comptes pilote son activité en lien avec les priorités business de Danone sur l’ensemble des catégories (WATERS /PLANT BASED/DAIRY), et saisit toutes les opportunités pour développer le CA, les PDM et la rentabilité de son parc. Les missions sont réparties en 2 pans : Business/Clients : Négocie des accords optimaux avec les points de vente finaux : groupements de restauration, groupements hôteliers, palaces, mini-chaînés VAE… Garantit le meilleur assortiment possible chez chacun de ses clients tout en optimisant son mix produit Prospecte les KOL clés de sa région (en collaboration avec le CVR) et y référence nos marques Danone Gère l’administratif associé à son portefeuille client, pilote ses budgets, traite la facturation Endosse un rôle d’ambassadeur de nos marques auprès de ses clients et lors d’événements CHR (SIRHA, EQUIPHOTEL…) Partage son expertise auprès des Chefs de Marché de son équipe Pilotage/Reporting : Pilote son P&L en phase avec les objectifs de l’entreprise Gère l’administratif associé à son portefeuille client, pilote ses budgets, traite la facturation Reporte avec rigueur les indicateurs de son business Travaille en lien et sur des projets spécifiques avec l’équipe DCN GC S’applique et applique aux autres la démarche Santé Sécurité Wise Nos engagements employeur : La garantie d’un package de rémunération pertinent, compétitif et évolutif grâce à un benchmark externe et une équité interne. Il se compose entre autres d’un salaire fixe, d’un variable annuel, d’une prime d’intéressement et/ou participation et d’une action Danone. Le développement des compétences de chacun avec la Danone Academy France et un cycle de conversation managérial. La possibilité d’utiliser 3 jours par an de bénévolat via notre plateforme Vendredi. data.title: ALTERNANCE - Achats Fruits Légumes First Diet - Septembre 2026 - (H/F)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans !  Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens.  Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs.   TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE :    Souhaitez-vous rejoindre une équipe diversifiée et passionnée, axée sur, la qualité et la performance ? Êtes-vous une personne orientée données, dotée de solides capacités analytiques et capable de gérer des projets avec des parties prenantes internes et externes ? Cette alternance se déroulera à Limonest, dans notre siège social à partir de Septembre 2026 dans les équipes Achats First Diet (nutrition infantile). Vous intégrerez l’organisation globale Cycles & Procurement de Danone, au sein de l’équipe en charge du sourcing global des ingrédients First Diet (nutrition infantile). Vous rejoindrez une équipe d’acheteurs engagés dont l’objectif est de sécuriser les approvisionnements et piloter la performance en matière de coûts, qualité, service et durabilité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les différents acheteurs de l'équipe, notamment ceux basés en France, aux Pays-Bas et en Pologne. Support au portefeuille Fruits & Légumes (80%) : Réalisations d’appels d’offres Sourcing de nouveaux fournisseurs Gestion de projets (sécurisation, économies, durabilité) Réduction des risques de rupture matières Support dans la gestion des contrats fournisseurs Évaluation des risques juridiques avec les fournisseurs Sujets transverses (20%) Définition de la feuille de route légale et coordination avec les acheteurs de l’équipe Mise à jour du Plan de Continuité Business pour l’équipe achat ingrédients LES + DE CETTE ALTERNANCE :    Jusqu’à 2 jours/sem de télétravail  Prise en charge intégrale de ton abonnement de transport en région parisienne/lyonnaise ou remboursement partiel/intégral de tes frais kilométriques sur nos sites de production. L’accès au programme "Vendredi je grandis" : un programme de développement et d'accompagnement sur mesure chaque vendredi après-midi, couvrant des sujets tels que la carrière, les soft skills et les hard skills.     Alternance : Ta rémunération dépendra de notre grille salariale en fonction de ton âge et de ton niveau d’études. A PROPOS DE VOUS Pour faire de grandes choses ensembles, nous recherchons pour ce poste quelqu’un de :  Disponible à partir de septembre 2026 pour une durée d'un an De niveau Bac+4/5 en université, école de commerce ou ingénieur  De nature analytique, rigoureux(se) et proactif(ve) À l’aise avec Excel, tu sais analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations concrètes Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, d’organisation et sais prioriser dans un environnement dynamique et exigeant Tu as une bonne aisance relationnelle et aimes travailler au plus près des équipes business et échanger avec différents services A PROPOS DE NOUS Pendant ton alternance, tu préfères prendre des notes ou des initiatives ?    90% de nos stagiaires et alternants estiment que Danone offre un environnement de travail propice à l’évolution professionnelle grâce aux responsabilités, à l’autonomie et aux formations accordées (source Happy Trainees). REJOINDRE DANONE C’EST…   Rencontrer des Danoners aux personnalités singulières, profils divers et aux parcours professionnels variés  Grandir dans des environnements différents : sites de production, bases logistiques, centre de recherche et innovation ou encore sièges sociaux  Se construire un parcours de carrière sur mesure, adapté à ta personnalité, tes compétences et tes envies  Apprendre grâce à des missions responsabilisantes, riches et apprenantes.   Nos Danoners ont la parole ! data.title: CDI - Manager R&I AI & Algorithm - (H/F)
data.description: About The Job Danone France is not trying to be the best company in the world, but the best company for the world! That's why all 26 of our brands in France are B Corp™ certified. B Corp is the compass that guides our CSR strategy! This certification allows us to challenge ourselves, continually improve and measure our social and environmental performance. Danone's research and innovation (R&I) centre, located in Gif-sur-Yvette on the Saclay plateau, is a global center of excellence dedicated to food innovation research. Inaugurated in 2023, this ultra-modern center is at the heart of one of the world's leading scientific hubs. It is home to more than 500 passionate experts of 40 different nationalities, working in the fields of life sciences, health and nutrition, consumer experience and the development of tomorrow's products. Equipped with laboratories and pilot facilities, it supports innovation and development. The Danone R&I Center is part of a global research ecosystem designed to foster collaboration with food technology start-ups and accelerate innovation in partnership with consumers and food and health stakeholders. About Danone's DDAI Transformation in Research & Innovation : At Danone, our Research & Innovation (R&I) division is at the heart of our mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible. To invent the future of food and become truly future-fit, we have launched DDAI (Data, Digital & AI), a transformative program designed to revolutionize our R&I landscape. Our DDAI strategy is focused on delivering significant value across six strategic flagships, including pioneering work in Gut Health & Microbiome, In Silico Modeling, Consumer Insights, and Digitization & Efficiency. The DDAI Lab's mission is to accelerate the delivery of these initiatives, build the strong data foundations needed to power AI, and ensure we focus on the most valuable projects. We are currently driving our top 20 priority projects; a dynamic portfolio composed of 14 high-impact use cases and 6 foundational projects. Join us to be a part of reshaping the future of food and wellness ! Position Overwiew : Reporting to the Director of DDAI Tech & AI, the R&I AI & Algorithm Manager is the scientific and technical leader for all our artificial intelligence initiatives and will: Lead the Algorithm & AI approach for R&I, including the vision for Generative AI to keep Danone at the forefront of technological solutions and scientific breakthroughs. The candidate should be able to participate to the development of algorithm itself Ensure methodology rigor and excellence and encourage a delivery mindset Direct the design, development of advanced AI and optimization algorithms, leading (transversal management) the data science team to solve complex challenges across all DDAI use cases. Establish and oversee AI governance and best practices, ensuring all AI products are robust, scalable, ethically sound, and deliver maximum business impact. Key Responsibilities : Define and execute the Algorithm & AI approach to comply with the R&I Strategy. This includes GenAI, ensuring alignment with company goals. Drive innovation by leading a technological watch and fostering collaboration with internal teams, universities, and external labs. Lead the end-to-end AI product lifecycle, from designing and optimizing advanced algorithms to overseeing the scaling of robust products, while implementing MLOps best practices. Lead, mentor, and manage the Data Scientist & Data Analyst team (MNS Data Science team) as their technical leader. Animate the R&I Science & Data community to mutualize expertise and ensure the adoption of best practices across all DDAI use cases. Establish AI and GenAI governance guidelines to mitigate risks, in alignment with the central DDAI governance framework. Our employer commitments: The guarantee of a relevant, competitive and scalable compensation package, through external benchmark and internal equity. It consists among other things of a fixed salary, an yearly bonus, gain sharing. Flexibility of work and workplaces, such as weekly homeworking. Skills development for all, thanks to our Danone Academy France and through a year-round managerial conversation cycle. The possibility to use up to 3 days a year of volunteering through the platform Vendredi. Parenting policy benefits, such as extended Parental Leave (14 additional maternity/paternity days covered), or the ability to convert some earnings into time off. Other benefits include a complementary pension scheme, health care plan, CSE, 100% of the Navigo pass covered About You The criteria below remain indicative. A candidate who has a different combination of experience and skills could also be considered: Master’s/Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science or related field 7+ years in data science, 5+ years in leadership Expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI Strong experience of delivering high-stake AI and GenAI industrialized products (NLP projects, RAG, …) Proficiency in cloud platforms, data engineering tools, AI, and MLOps frameworks Experience in integrating AI solutions into cloud infrastructure and with Microsoft Copilot Strong understanding of software engineering principles including CI/CD, clean code, and code packaging for industrialization Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills Experience in biology and food sciences We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunity within our teams. We believe that our differences will make a difference, and that an inclusive work environment will drive our growth as a company, as a team, and as individuals. We will therefore consider all applications* by fostering an inclusive work culture where everyone can feel at home. We have also chosen to remove inclusive writing from our job offers because its complexity penalizes people with cognitive disabilities, including dyslexia, dysphasia, or apraxia. *All nominations will be considered regardless of origin, background, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability… About Us One Planet, One Health - BY YOU! Our four core values "HOPE": HUMANISM, OPENNESS, CLOSENESS and ENTHUSIASM serve as our compass. Every day, you will make decisions that impact our economic and societal performance, as well as our ability to achieve our ambitions. At Danone, you can just be yourself. We are convinced that it is up to YOU to define how you work, develop and progress. With us, you will work in a challenging, authentic, and caring environment. data.title: CDI - UX Manager Consumer Evaluation - (H/F)
data.description: About The Job Au sein de la division Danone Global Research & Innovation, sur le site de Paris-Saclay, l’équipe UX Global contribue à la performance globale de Danone et à celle des business units locales en offrant, via les produits, emballages et supports digitaux, des expériences utilisateurs pertinentes, supérieures et uniques. Votre mission Au cœur de la compréhension des comportements, usages et attentes des consommateurs, vous pilotez des études auprès de ces derniers à l’échelle mondiale, avec un fort accent sur les études quantitatives, afin d’éclairer la prise de décision (sur le produit, la marque et l’expérience). Vous intervenez sur des projets à fort impact, en lien étroit avec les équipes recherche et innovation, catégorie produit, marketing. Vous vous assurez qu’à chaque moment, avec chacun de vos interlocuteurs, la voix du consommateur est toujours au centre et prise en compte à sa juste mesure dans les décisions. Vos responsabilités Piloter opérationnellement les études quantitatives UX de leviers de préférence Construire et suivre des plans d’études en lien avec les enjeux produits et utilisateurs, en collaboration avec la communauté UX dans les pays Proposer et mettre en place des protocoles d’études quantitatives et / ou qualitatives en réponse à des interrogations des métiers sur les comportements et attentes consommateurs (cadrage, méthodologie, terrain, analyse) Collaborer avec des instituts partenaires et challenger leurs recommandations Analyser et interpréter les résultats pour en extraire des enseignements actionnables, à un niveau global comme local. Mener des analyses transversales (pays / catégorie) ou des analyses approfondies (sur des bénéfices consommateurs ou des thématiques spécifiques) Concevoir des supports de restitution clairs, pédagogiques et impactants (présentations, tableaux de bord, synthèses) Formuler des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l’expérience consommateur Enrichir les analyses en les croisant avec les insights générés par les autres entités Danone (équipes UX globales et locales, équipes d’analyse sensorielle, équipes marketing, etc.) Ponctuellement, conduire des études exploratoires au-delà des catégories produit du marché, pour alimenter le portfolio d’innovations par des leviers de valeur consommateur. Accompagner les communautés UX (globale et locales) et plus largement les autres entités Danone dans les approches méthodologiques et l’appropriation des insights About You Votre profil 5 ans minimum d’expérience en études UX / Consumer insights, en institut d’études ou chez un annonceur Une expérience en test de produits alimentaires serait un plus Solide maîtrise des méthodes quantitatives (questionnaires, analyses statistiques) Bonne culture UX et sensibilité aux usages et à l’expérience utilisateur À l’aise avec l’analyse de données et la mise en récit des résultats Une expérience complémentaire en sciences comportementales et cognitives sera appréciée Aisance relationnelle, vous permettant d’interagir avec des équipes multiculturelles et des parties prenantes globales et locales Capacité à travailler en forte transversalité, à fédérer et à faire avancer des projets impliquant des interlocuteurs variés Excellente capacité d’écoute, de synthèse et de communication Autonomie, rigueur, curiosité et sens de l’impact (stratégique, synthétique, visuel) Anglais courant About Us Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? La mission de Danone est d’apporter la santé par l’alimentation au plus grand nombre, et nous croyons que seule une expérience produit savoureuse peut encourager les consommateurs à aller vers des habitudes alimentaires plus saines. L’UX est une fonction clé au sein de la Recherche & Innovation, qui transforme les insights consommateurs et sensoriels en leviers de conception produit afin de créer des expériences produits que les consommateurs adorent. Nous offrons : Un environnement collaboratif, orienté consommateurs et données, où chacun contribue concrètement à créer des expériences produits meilleures et plus responsables. Un rôle clé dans la stratégie UX Des projets variés, utiles, visibles et à impact Une équipe à taille humaine, accessible, pragmatique et orientée résultats. On aime comprendre, tester, ajuster… et surtout faire simple et utile. On valorise la clarté, l’autonomie et le bon sens, dans un environnement de travail fluide et collaboratif About The Job Within Danone Global Research & Innovation, based in the Paris-Saclay, the Global UX team contributes to Danone’s overall performance as well as that of local business units by delivering relevant, superior, and distinctive user experiences through products, packaging, and digital touchpoints. Your mission At the heart of understanding consumer behaviors, usages and expectations, you lead global UX studies with a strong focus on quantitative research to support decision-making related to product, brand, and experience. You work on high-impact projects in close collaboration with Research & Innovation, Category, and Marketing teams. At every stage and with every stakeholder, you ensure that the consumer voice remains central and is appropriately considered in decision-making Your responsibilities Leading UX research Operationally lead quantitative UX studies focused on preference drivers Build and manage research plans aligned with product and user challenges, in collaboration with the UX community in the countries Design and implement quantitative and/or qualitative research protocols to answer business questions related to consumer behaviors and expectations (scope definition, methodology, fieldwork, analysis) Work closely with external research agencies and challenge their recommendations Analysis & insights Analyze and interpret results to generate actionable insights at both global and local levels Conduct cross-country and cross-category analyses, as well as deep-dive analyses on specific consumer benefits or themes Design clear, educational, and impactful deliverables (presentations, dashboards, executive summaries) Formulate concrete recommendations to improve consumer experience Enrich analyses by cross-referencing insights generated by other Danone teams (global and local UX teams, sensory analysis teams, marketing, etc.) Knowledge sharing & innovation Occasionally lead exploratory studies beyond existing product categories to fuel the innovation pipeline with consumer value drivers Support global and local UX communities—and more broadly other Danone teams—in research methodologies and insight adoption About You Your profile Minimum 5 years’ experience in UX research / consumer insights, either in a research agency or on the client side An experience in food product tests is a plus Strong expertise in quantitative methods (questionnaires, statistical analysis) Solid UX culture and sensitivity to usage and user experience Comfortable with data analysis and storytelling Background in behavioral and cognitive sciences is a plus Strong interpersonal skills, enabling collaboration with multicultural teams and global/local stakeholders Proven ability to work cross-functionally, mobilize stakeholders, and drive projects forward Excellent listening, synthesis, and communication skills Autonomous, rigorous, curious, and impact-driven Fluent in English About Us Why join us? Danone’s mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible, and we believe that only delicious food experience will engage people towards healthier food habit. UX is a key function within Research & Innovation that transforms consumer and sensory insights into product design levers to create product experience that consumers love. We offer: A collaborative, consumer and data-driven environment, where everyone contributes tangibly to creating better and more responsible product experiences A key role in the UX strategy Diverse, meaningful, visible, and high-impact projects A human-sized team that is accessible, pragmatic, and results-oriented. We enjoy understanding, testing, iterating—and above all, keeping things simple and useful. We value clarity, autonomy, and common sense in a smooth and collaborative working environment

C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens.  Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. data.title: APRENTICESHIP - Impact Manager Danone Ecosystem  - September - (W/M)
data.description: About The Job Within the Danone Ecosystem team, this apprenticeship will take place in Rueil-Malmaison (France), at our headquarters, starting from September 2026. Danone Ecosystem is a Non-For-Profit organization working with communities and partners to build the food system of tomorrow while transforming Danone’s value chain into one that is healthy, circular, sustainable, regenerative and inclusive. Concretely, Danone Ecosystem co-creates inclusive business solutions for the general interest through the professional empowerment of vulnerable stakeholders together with Non for Profit organizations and Danone Country business units. Since its creation in 2009, Danone Ecosystem has financed more than 100 projects, empowered > 80 000 professionals and positively impacted 6 million people in more than 30 countries. It has been a laboratory on social innovation, implementing new business models and bringing projects to sustainability and scale. Over the years, the Danone Ecosystem team has developed recognized expertise in inclusive business models, societal innovation, co-creation, stakeholder’s engagement and management, complex project management, as well as robust impact assessment. Indeed, “impact” is our compass: we build impact driven projects by defining from the beginning, the impact we want to achieve – whether it is environmental, social, and/or for people’s health - and we set the conditions to do so. Moreover, we have a clear impact assessment policy to define, measure, assess and share our impacts in order to prove and improve what we do, and inspire others. Impact assessments are at the heart of our models, as it provides clear evidence of their efficiency and the results can foster the need for all willing actors (government, companies, NGOs, ...) to replicate. For more information visit our pages: - Website http://ecosysteme.danone.com/ - LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/danone-ecosystem/posts/?feedView=all In 2023, the new Impact Assessment Strategy for Danone Ecosystem was written, and we today need support to make it live! YOUR MISSIONS AT DANONE: More concretely, it means that your mission would be to: Support the Senior Impact Manager for the management of the pre-design studies and/or impact assessments for different Nature projects on Regenerative Agriculture, Watershed protection or Recycling. For the pre-design studies and impact assessments, your role would be to contribute to the design of studies for new projects (building of Theories of Change, writing of Research for Proposal, research of the local experts to delegate the evaluation to, contract, co-building of the research protocol), and to follow-up the different current studies (preparation of the steerco, link with the experts and with the projects teams, review of the protocols or final reports, sensemaking workshops) Finalize the “impact toolkit” to help Danone Ecosystem project coordinators to be better equipped for the pre-design studies and impact assessments of their projects – mission to be confirmed depending on the progress when the apprenticeship will start Support the Engagement, Communication and Knowledge team for the communication about Danone Ecosystem impact expertise, studies and results a. Capture and formalize knowledge to make the research outcomes of the impact studies accessible for non-scientific stakeholders (co-financers, politics, NGOs, …) b. Support the engagement and communication team on the valorization of these results c. Contribute to all the communication done to share Danone Ecosystem impact expertise and ways of working. THE BENEFITS OF THIS APPRENTICESHIP: Up to 2 days/week of remote work Full reimbursement of your public transportation pass or partial/full reimbursement of mileage expenses "Vendredi je grandis" program: development every Friday afternoon covering career, soft skills, and hard skills. Apprenticeship : Your compensation will depend on our salary scale based on your age and level of study. Benefits: company restaurant, gym, bike parking About You For this position, we are looking for someone: Available from September 2026 for a duration of 1 year At the level of Bac+4/5 in university, business school, or engineering school You have experience in evaluation, impact assessment (quantitative and qualitative), project management, research Experience in multidisciplinary approaches, ideally with deeper expertise in specific fields like agriculture, environment, food, health, social impact and/or sustainability Capacity to collaborate and develop partnerships with multiple internal and external stakeholders (NGOs, public institutions, research centers…) Relationship and mediation capabilities with scientific experts You are structured, proactive, and able to own and drive your topics. Ability to work with a high level of autonomy and to deliver on various projects and deadlines Constructive mindset and openness Fluent English (mandatory) Good level of French (professional level, nice to have) Spanish is appreciated About Us We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunity within our teams. We believe that our differences make a difference and that an inclusive work environment will foster our growth as a company, as teams and as individuals. We will therefore consider all applications* by fostering an inclusive work culture where everyone can feel like they belong. *All applications will be considered regardless of origin, background, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability... data.description: About The Job A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans !  Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens.  Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs.   TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE :    Cette alternance se déroulera à Limonest, dans notre siège social à partir de septembre 2026. Fabienne, manager Conformité Qualité et Food Safety, t’accompagnera pour grandir au quotidien et t’épanouir dans tes missions : • Animer les certifications Bio et Rainforest Alliance Contribuer à la gestion des systèmes de certification (Bio & RFA) : préparation des audits annuels, gestion documentaire des certificats, suivi des évolutions réglementaires, validation des nouveaux emballages avec les organismes certificateurs. Identifier les axes d’amélioration et proposer des actions correctives afin de renforcer la robustesse et la performance du système. • Contribuer à la gestion des risques émergents Participer à la rédaction de « position papers » et à l’analyse des risques émergents en lien avec les enjeux de sécurité des aliments et de conformité. • Accompagner l’activité de relation consommateurs / clients Former le centre d’appels afin d’optimiser la qualité du traitement des contacts consommateurs et clients, et garantir l’application des processus QFS. • Participer à des projets d’amélioration continue QFS Contribuer à des projets transverses (innovation, rénovation produits…) incluant la préparation de Q&A, ainsi que la création et la mise à jour de procédures. data.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR DDAI PROGRAMS
data.description: About The Job Danone France is not trying to be the best company in the world, but the best company for the world! That's why all 26 of our brands in France are B Corp™ certified. B Corp is the compass that guides our CSR strategy! This certification allows us to challenge ourselves, continually improve and measure our social and environmental performance. Danone's research and innovation (R&I) centre, located in Gif-sur-Yvette on the Saclay plateau, is a global center of excellence dedicated to food innovation research. Inaugurated in 2023, this ultra-modern center is at the heart of one of the world's leading scientific hubs. It is home to more than 500 passionate experts of 40 different nationalities, working in the fields of life sciences, health and nutrition, consumer experience and the development of tomorrow's products. Equipped with laboratories and pilot facilities, it supports innovation and development. The Danone R&I Center is part of a global research ecosystem designed to foster collaboration with food technology start-ups and accelerate innovation in partnership with consumers and food and health stakeholders. DDAI (Data, Digital & AI) is one of the strategic pillars of Danone’s global R&I transformation. It exists to accelerate how we innovate — by embedding digital, data and artificial intelligence into every step of our scientific, product, and operational workflows. DDAI enables R&I teams to deliver faster, better, and more confidently, turning complex science and insights into real business impact DDAI plays a pivotal role in: Accelerating innovation through digital twins, in‑silico models, advanced analytics, and GenAI tools. Strengthening scientific capabilities with proprietary AI models and integrated data ecosystems. Improving efficiency and compliance by digitizing QFS & R&I processes, enabling faster regulatory workflows. Upskilling the organization through the DDAI Academy and cross‑functional collaboration with IT&Data and QFS. DDAI is building the digital, data and AI backbone of Danone R&I. Joining DDAI means joining a purpose‑driven, pioneering team at the heart of how Danone reinvents health through food, reshaping how Danone designs the next generation of products, services, and scientific breakthroughs powered by science and technology. Position Overview : Reporting directly to the VP Global R&I Digital and AI, the Senior Director DDAI Programs is a pivotal leadership role responsible for orchestrating complex, cross-functional programs that are reshaping our innovation pipeline. This role is a key driver for the entire R&I transformation. You will: Lead the successful execution, integration, and scaling of our most critical DDAI initiatives across R&I. Be accountable for the R&I delivery and maximize the business impact of our flagship programs, which are designed to drive business superiority and team performance. Co-lead/co-shape a business big bet by leading the strategy, development, and delivery of one key DDAI program (related to Gut health), acting as Product Director and guiding Product Owners. Lead a talented team of DDAI Product Directors, ensuring our strategic goals are turned into real-world solutions with speed and impact. Key Responsibilities : Drive Strategy to Action: Build, shape, and deliver the DDAI strategy, translating it into a 1-3 year action plan for effective execution and scaling across R&I flagships. Maximize Impact: Hold accountability for R&I delivery and impact maximization, ensuring programs provide strong value and build the right capabilities. Executive Influence & Partnership: Act as primary business partner, regularly interacting with Senior Management. Ensure strategic alignment with internal and cross-functional clients (Marketing, Operations, Supply). Transformation & Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop DDAI Product Directors, acting as a change agent to accelerate value, speed, and simplification. Deliver through others, flexing leadership style as required. Resource & Governance: Partner with the DDAI Strategic Office to secure talent and budget. Navigate conflicts pragmatically, prioritizing Danone First. Holistic View & Foresight: Bring the outside in (R&I trends, market dynamics) to shape "what’s next". Maintain a holistic view of R&I’s x-functional contribution. About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant business, engineering, or science field. 15+ years of leadership experience in a technology, data, or digital transformation environment. Experience in Food CPG, or Pharmaceutical R&I is a plus. Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to build, shape, and deliver a strategy, coupled with strong business acumen. Execution & Impact: Demonstrated excellence in Program Leadership, with a proven track record of executing and scaling complex, high-impact programs. Senior Leadership & Influence: Ability to influence at the executive level and a proven track record of acting as an agent of driving value, speed, and simplification. Cross-Functional Delivery: Experience in leading large programs across multiple domains and functions (multi-function horizontal/vertical engagement) and delivering through internal and external networks. Functional & Personal Skills: Strong self-drive and the ability to act as an expert/own a domain, alongside problem-solving fundamentals and experience as a change agent willing to challenge the status quo. About Us We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunities within our teams. We believe that our differences make a difference and that an inclusive working environment will stimulate our growth as a company, as teams and as individuals. We will therefore consider all applications*, promoting an inclusive working culture where everyone can feel they belong. We have also decided to remove inclusive writing from our job offers because its complexity penalises people with cognitive disabilities, such as dyslexia, dysphasia or apraxia. *All applications will be considered regardless of origin, background, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or disability... One Planet, One Health - BY YOU! Our four ‘HOPE’ values: HUMANISM, OPENNESS, PROXIMITY and ENTHUSIASM serve as our compass. Every day, you will make decisions that have an impact on our economic and social performance, as well as on our ability to achieve our ambitions. At Danone, you can simply be yourself. We believe it's up to YOU to define the way you work, develop and grow. With us, you'll work in a challenging, authentic and caring environment.

MISSION The Strategy Manager, Dairy & PBCategory, supports the development and implementation of strategic initiatives to drive the growth and sustainability of Danone’s Dairy & PB business. Working closely with the Dairy & PB Category leadership, global functions, zone teams, and CBUs, the Strategy Manager helps translate the global category strategy into actionable initiatives and supports the execution and monitoring of these plans at both global and local levels. This role will take place in Paris, in our head office, as soon as possible. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Support the development or refinement of the Dairy & PB category’s 3- to 5-year strategic roadmap, in collaboration with Strategy & Insights, Finance, Operations, Platforms, Brands and other relevant teams. Assist in the translation of global Dairy & PB strategies into actionable plans for zones and CBUs, ensuring alignment and consistency across the organization. This can be in the form of toolkits, frameworks, playbooks or workshops. Coordinate and track the implementation of strategic initiatives, identifying potential risks and opportunities, and providing regular updates to stakeholders. Prepare and deliver clear, impactful presentations and toolkits to communicate strategic priorities and progress to internal teams. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective execution of strategic projects, sharing best practices and supporting capability building within the Dairy & PB category. Acting as Secretary to the Global Dairy & PB Leadership Team Monthly Meeting, setting agenda, steering the conversation, acting as time-keeper, sending and following up on minutes. Contribute to business case development, financial modeling, and scenario analysis to support decision-making. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, representing the Dairy & PB category in relevant forums and working groups. KEY DELIVERABLES AND KPI Effective tracking and reporting of strategic initiative progress and outcomes. High-quality presentations and toolkits to support strategic alignment and execution. Uncovering and sizing potential growth, profitability, and efficiency opps within the Dairy & PB category. End-to-End lead on strategic projects. data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Au sein de la Division Danone Specialized Nutrition, à proximité de Lille, l'usine de Steenvoorde est une usine clé fournissant des recettes complexes à hautes valeurs ajoutées. L'usine de Steenvoorde se trouve au début d'une transformation technologique et organisationnelle, pour répondre aux futurs marchés en termes de portefeuille de produits et aux exigences qualité et sécurité des aliments. Danone Steenvoorde c’est : Plus de 430 Danoners qui œuvrent chaque jour pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients en assurant la qualité des produits, la sécurité des femmes et des hommes et la réduction de notre impact sur l’environnement. Plus de 65 000 tonnes de produits sont fabriqués chaque année et exportés dans plus de 45 pays. data.title: CDD - Overheads Controller (M/F) - 12 months
data.description: About The Job For over 100 years, we’ve been by your side, all across France! At Danone, we believe growth is something to be savored. That’s why our 26 brands are part of the everyday lives of French consumers, offering delicious products that bring enjoyment while taking care of oneself and loved ones. With more than 8,000 Danoners across 13 production sites, 7 warehouses, 3 headquarters and an R&D center, Danone continuously works on developing and enhancing iconic products found in your kitchens, supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, as well as in healthcare facilities and pharmacies. Certified B Corp and Happy Trainees, Danone does not aim to be the best company in the world, but a better company for the world. We strive to offer the very best to both our consumers and our people. Danone SA is looking for a Finance Overheads controller in France (FR) based in Paris (La Fayette). With our global presence, brands and business within our mission "bringing health through food to as many people as possible", we believe that people growth is a key asset to reach a sustainable business performance. Take this opportunity to GROW together ! This role is part of the Danone SA Corporate team, you will report directly to Head of OVH Controlling. In this role, following aspects belong to your playfield : Coordinate and structure the financial activities across Danone’s corporate entities and international holding structures. Act as a key liaison with Danone counterparts across Finance, HR, GS, and other stakeholders. Support decision‑making related to Group Short‑Term Cost Planning & Control. Establish and maintain an effective follow‑up structure for all fixed costs. Prepare and present business insights to the management team and the Corporate Finance Director. Manage FTE costs, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with business needs. Identify financial risks and opportunities and drive the related action plans to secure performance.  Contribute actively to the delivery of the strategic Finance Roadmap. This will enable you to the following : Be part of the finance team with an ambitious journey, particulary focused on driving automation Gain exposure to stakeholders and develop a strong business‑partnering mindset Develop a clear understanding of overheads and directly influence performance and results Our employer commitments: The guarantee of a relevant, competitive and scalable compensation package, through external benchmark and internal equity. It consists among other things of a fixed salary, an yearly bonus, gain sharing. Flexibility of work and workplaces, such as weekly homeworking. Skills development for all, thanks to our Danone Academy France and through a year-round managerial conversation cycle. The possibility to use up to 3 days a year of volunteering through the platform Vendredi. Parenting policy benefits, such as extended Parental Leave (14 additional maternity/paternity days covered), or the ability to convert some earnings into time off Other benefits include a complementary pension scheme, health care plan, CSE, 100% of the Navigo pass covered About You The criteria below remain indicative. A candidate who has a different combination of experience and skills could also be considered.   You have 3-5 years experience in Controlling in a large and international context You build trustful relationships internally through good communication: able to explain simply complex concepts or analysis, understand issues of stakeholders from various functions, capacity to animate non-Finance people. You are never afraid of challenging status quo and drive with energy to make things happen You have a structured mindset, are rigorous with figures and processes A good Knowledge of SAP & BI systems is an asset Team spirit Fluent in English and French We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunities within our teams. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and that an inclusive work environment supports our growth as a company, as teams, and as individuals. We therefore welcome all applications* while fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can feel they belong. We have also chosen to remove inclusive writing from our job descriptions, as its complexity can create barriers for individuals with cognitive disabilities, including dyslexia, dysphasia or apraxia. *All applications will be considered regardless of origin, background, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic. About Us One Planet, One Health - BY YOU ! Our four core values "HOPE": HUMANISM, OPENNESS, CLOSENESS and ENTHUSIASM serve as our compass. Every day, you will make decisions that impact our economic and societal performance, as well as our ability to achieve our ambitions. At Danone, you can just be yourself. We are convinced that it is up to YOU to define how you work, develop and progress. With us, you will work in a challenging, authentic, and caring environment. Want to know more about the daily life of our danoners? Check out our LinkedIn page and our @DanoneTalentFrance Instagram account. You want to take action to bring health through food to as many people as possible? Join us! #LI-FR

Au sein de la Division Danone Specialized Nutrition, à proximité de Lille, l'usine de Steenvoorde est une usine clé fournissant des recettes complexes à hautes valeurs ajoutées. L'usine de Steenvoorde se trouve au début d'une transformation technologique et organisationnelle, pour répondre aux futurs marchés en termes de portefeuille de produits et aux exigences qualité et sécurité des aliments. Danone Steenvoorde c’est : Plus de 430 Danoners qui œuvrent chaque jour pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients en assurant la qualité des produits, la sécurité des femmes et des hommes et la réduction de notre impact sur l’environnement. Pack Office : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils Microsoft (la maîtrise de VBA et des TCD sont des atouts supplémentaires). data.title: CDD 6 mois - Gestionnaire Flux Factures (H/F)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Danone France ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais meilleure pour le monde ! C'est pour cela que nos 26 marques en France sont certifiées B Corp TM. * B Corp est la boussole de notre stratégie RSE ! Cette certification permet de nous remettre en question afin de progresser continuellement et mesurer notre performance sociale et environnementale. Danone a créé un centre d’excellence (Finance, Ressources Humaines, Master Data) qui renforce la mutualisation des activités et des modes de fonctionnement. Ces fonctions sont regroupées au sein du département One Danone Business Services France (ODBS France). Rejoignez le département ODBS en tant que Gestionnaire Flux Factures – Déploiement Esker. Ce CDD de 6 mois débutera en juillet 2026 et sera basé à Rueil-Malmaison (92500). Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :  Le/la Gestionnaire Flux Factures intervient en amont du workflow I2C : il/elle assure la réception, le tri et l’enrichissement des flux de facturation entrants dans l’outil Esker (orientation sur les bons comptes clients, mise à jour des données de référence, gestion des doublons), afin de permettre la bonne exécution du circuit de validation puis de clôture pour comptabilisation et paiement. Traitement et tri des flux dans le module Triage Esker Réceptionner les documents entrants dans le module Triage Esker : avis de virements, notes de débit et factures Trades Terms Identifier et basculer les factures Trades Terms vers le module Gestion des Factures Esker Séparer et orienter correctement les différents types de documents selon les circuits définis Réceptionner les factures papier, les scanner et les transmettre à l’adresse mail Esker dédiée afin qu’elles intègrent le circuit de traitement standard (module Triage puis Gestion des Factures) Identifier les expéditeurs qui continuent d’envoyer leurs factures à l’ancienne adresse mail Archibald (outil précédent) et leur adresser un mail de correction pour les réorienter vers la nouvelle adresse Esker Affectation des factures aux comptes clients dans le module Gestion des Factures Ouvrir chaque facture Trades Terms dans le module Gestion des Factures et renseigner le compte client correspondant via le numéro de TVA Intracommunautaire Lorsqu’aucun numéro de compte client ne remonte via le numéro de TVA Intraco, ouvrir un ticket Orsoft auprès de l’équipe Master Data afin d’intégrer l’information manquante sur la fiche client Assurer le suivi des tickets Orsoft ouverts jusqu’à la mise à jour effective de la fiche client et la bonne affectation de la facture Contrôle qualité et remontée des anomalies Détecter et supprimer les doublons de factures présents dans les flux Esker Identifier et remonter au Manager tout problème ou anomalie détecté dans le traitement des flux (erreurs de routage, données manquantes, incohérences) Contribuer à la fiabilisation continue des données et des processus de traitement dans l’outil Nos engagements employeur : La garantie d'un package de rémunération pertinent, compétitif et évolutif grâce à un benchmark externe et une équité interne. Il se compose entre autres d'un salaire fixe, d'un variable annuel, d'une prime d’intéressement et/ou participation. Une flexibilité de travail et lieux de travail avec télétravail hebdomadaire. A adapter en fonction de l’équipe. Le développement des compétences de chacun avec la Danone Academy France et un cycle de conversation managérial. La possibilité d'utiliser 3 jours par an de bénévolat via notre plateforme Vendredi. data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Danone France ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais meilleure pour le monde ! Au sein de la Division Danone Specialized Nutrition, à proximité de Lille, l'usine de Steenvoorde est une usine clé fournissant des recettes complexes à hautes valeurs ajoutées. L'usine de Steenvoorde se trouve au début d'une transformation technologique et organisationnelle, pour répondre aux futurs marchés en termes de portefeuille de produits et aux exigences qualité et sécurité des aliments. Danone Steenvoorde c’est : Plus de 450 Danoners qui œuvrent chaque jour pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients en assurant la qualité des produits, la sécurité des femmes et des hommes et la réduction de notre impact sur l’environnement. Plus de 65 000 tonnes de produits sont fabriqués chaque année et exportés dans plus de 45 pays. Un portefeuille de 140 recettes pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients exigeants. 4 lignes de conditionnement (3 sur le liquide et 1 sur la poudre), 1 tour de séchage et 1 atelier ingrédient Et prochainement l'implémentation d'une nouvelle ligne de produit médicaux Nous recherchons notre futur Danoner pour travailler dans notre super usine de Steenvoorde. data.title: APRENTICESHIP - Global reward apprentice - September 2026- (H/F)
data.description: About The Job By your side, all over the world, for over 100 years! Danone enriches the daily lives of all with 26 brands of delicious products that allow people to indulge while caring for themselves and their loved ones. With more than 100,000 Danoners operating across 26 countries, Danone continuously creates and develops iconic products that you will find in your kitchen, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes or for healthcare establishments and pharmacies. As a B Corp certified company, Danone does not seek to be the best company in the world, but a better company for the world. We strive to offer the best to our consumers and employees. YOUR MISSIONS AT DANONE: Within the Global Reward team, this apprenticeship will take place in Paris (75009), at our headquarters starting from September 2026. The global reward team will support you to thrive in your missions: Animate our Reward community: Training, presentation, documentation (25%) Support in our annual compensation cycle (ASR & STI process): monitoring, data consolidation... (25%) Animate Post-Mortem: gather stakeholders feedback via survey/meeting and build an action plan to improve next year cycle (10%) Co-create global benefits policies: Global parental policy, Flexible benefits... (15%) Support in our Benefits projects & policies (building Global Prevention program, roll out of Caregiver policy, Cancer pledge, Travel & Expenses policy and Car policy) (10%) Support in our Compensation project: Living wage, European directive, Benchmarking (Mercer survey, …) (5%) Analyze data & Reporting (Global Prevention program; quarterly audit, dataquality checks...) (10%) THE BENEFITS OF THIS APPRENTICESHIP/INTERNSHIP: Develop your skills in compensation & benefits Up to 2 days/week of remote work Working in Global reward team will allow you to work with an international team and learn about compensation and benefits practices across different countries, understanding how to navigate and comply with various local regulations. Apprenticeship: Your salary will depend on our apprentice salary grid, based on your age and level of education. About You Ready to become a real Danoner? We are looking for someone: Available from September for a duration of 12 months You have a 4 to 5 years study level from university, business school or engineering school Appetences: curious, communication skills, adaptability Language : Do you speak English ? We need someone who is fluent Softwares : you feel comfortable with Excel and Power point About Us More than 92% of our interns and apprentices recommend doing their internship, apprenticeship, or VIE at Danone (source: Happy Trainees). Could you be our next apprentice? JOINING DANONE MEANS… Meeting Danoners with unique personalities, diverse profiles, and various career paths. Growing in different environments: production sites, logistics bases, research and innovation centers, or headquarters. data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE DANONE ENTREPRISE A MISSION En Juin 2020, Danone est devenue la première entreprise cotée à adopter le statut d’Entreprise à Mission . Nous avons en effet décidé de nous doter d'une raison d'être et d'objectifs sociaux, sociétaux et environnementaux associés inscrits dans nos statuts. Il s’agit d’une étape historique pour continuer à réaliser chaque jour notre mission – « apporter la santé par l’alimentation au plus grand nombre » - dans notre cadre d’action « One Planet. One Health ». MISSION ET RESPONSABILITES Participe au développement du CA, au gain de PDM et à l’atteinte des KPIs du PICOS (Picture Of Success) par des actions de présence, de merchandising (visibilité), d’activation (mise en place des opérations promotionnelles ciblées) de nos marques à travers : La parfaite exécution des actions planifiées avec le CM sur le parc de magasins partagé avec le CM La vente et l’exécution des priorités business fixées par Danone pour atteindre la picture of success (PICOS) sur son parc propre (SM et Proxi) Principales activités : Assure l'excellence dans l'exécution de la mise en place des innovations et mouvements de gamme : bon endroit, bon nombre de facing, bonne publicité sur le lieu de vente, étiquette prix présente Traite les anomalies fond de rayon en mettant en place les actions correctives notamment la lutte anti-rupture Gère des actes merchandising : gain de PDL, iconisation de nos marques, mains en rayon, recadrages et implantations Monte les opérations promotionnelles négociées Saisit des opportunités de placer des meubles 2nd placements et en assure la gestion. Incarne au quotidien les 7 attitudes d’Agilité Commerciales AGCO Utilise tous les leviers de communication pour saisir les opportunités (visite physique, tél, visio, mail, etc.) Saisie avec rigueur les indicateurs de son business dans son outil CRM Gère en propre un parc de 2 à 10 magasins où il est responsable de la parfaite exécution des gammes référencées. data.title: Export Customer Service Manager (Fixed-Term Mission)
data.description: About The Job Danone's Evian Volvic Alpro International Business Unit is looking for its next Export Customer Service Manager. This position is based in Evian-Les-Bains (74) for a temporary mission (12 months). The Customer Service manager is responsible for driving operational performance within their functional area (Back Office Operationst). They act as the leader for their team, ensuring daily execution excellence, process alignment, and smooth coordination with cross‑functional stakeholders. They provide day‑to‑day guidance, prioritization, and expertise to their team and ensure strong service delivery towards internal and external customers. One of the key challenges is to structure and improve ways of working to make it more efficient. Transversal leadership will be a key asset to perform. You report to the EVAI Supply Chain and Customer Solution Senior Manager based in Evian-Les-Bains. Customer Service Coordinate and prioritize daily activities within the functional team to meet service, quality, and efficiency targets. Act as the operational subject‑matter expert for the scope (customer collaboration, back‑office operations, or seafreight booking). Ensure adherence to processes, data quality standards, escalation routines, and service level agreements. Support issue resolution and serve as the primary escalation point for operational topics within the scope. Monitor performance metrics (KPIs) and propose corrective actions when necessary. Collaborate with other teams (Customer Collaboration, Planning, Logistics, Finance, IT) to ensure end‑to‑end operational flow. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and process harmonization. Provide functional coaching and on‑the‑job support to team members. Prepare and consolidate reporting to management on operational performance, risks, and opportunities. Support transformation projects and new ways‑of‑working deployment within the team. Continuous improvement Improve the way of working and be a key player in our organization for the below topics: Digitalization Simplification Change management Identify process or logistics optimizations to improve efficiency. Identify productivity opportunities. Improve our customers' experience, engaging customers and facilitating organic growth. Internal Contacts: Local Sales Team Export Supply Chain team Local Supply Chain team and Logistics team Local Marketing Team Local Business Controller Central Finance Team External Contacts: Distributors Transportation companies About You You have a Degree in Business Administration, in Engineering, or in a Supply-related field. You would typically have around 3 to 5 years relevant experience in Customer Service and/or Demand Planning, within a strong multinational FMCG company and/or export business company. You are a strong user of Microsoft Excel, SAP/APO knowledge is a plus. You are able to prioritize, and you possess strong Communication and Coordination Skills. You are rigorous. You are able to interact with multi-cultural stakeholders. You are known to be open-minded, pro-active and results oriented. You have a continuous improvement mindset. You are highly autonomous & flexible You speak English & French fluently. About Us Evian Volvic Alpro International (EVAI) is the international business unit behind the worldwide success of evian, Volvic, and Alpro, bringing premium healthy hydration and plant-based nutrition to more than 90 markets across the globe. Operating in 13 locations and powered by a culturally diverse team of more than 30 nationalities, EVAI offers an international playground. We are creating, nurturing and scaling up business geographies leveraging a large distributor network, powered by a sales & marketing force that activates locally, with a high level of autonomy, excellence in execution and entrepreneurial thinking. As part of Danone, we combine the agility of a lean organisation with the scale and purpose of a global group - offering broad opportunities for growth, leadership exposure, and meaningful impact supported by functional teams acting as strong business partners. Join EVAI and shape the future of iconic brands in a business where your voice matters, your potential is nurtured, and your impact is real.

data.title: Vivier - Controlling Manager - H/F
data.description: About The Job For over 100 years, we’ve been by your side, all across France! At Danone, we believe growth is something to be savored. That’s why our 26 brands are part of the everyday lives of French consumers, offering delicious products that bring enjoyment while taking care of oneself and loved ones. With more than 8,000 Danoners across 13 production sites, 7 warehouses, 3 headquarters and an R&D center, Danone continuously works on developing and enhancing iconic products found in your kitchens, supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, as well as in healthcare facilities and pharmacies. Certified B Corp and Happy Trainees, Danone does not aim to be the best company in the world, but a better company for the world. We strive to offer the very best to both our consumers and our people. You're looking to join Danone and grow with us, but can't find the right opportunity yet? This posting is for you — apply now to get ahead of our future needs! Join our talent pool and we'll reach out to set up an initial conversation when the right opportunity arises. Joining Danone's Finance team means playing a key role in driving performance at a purpose-led company, committed to the health of people and the planet. Our Controllers are trusted business partners — they bring clarity to decisions, challenge teams constructively, and actively contribute to strategy. Rigor, curiosity and a strong team spirit are at the heart of what they do. Key Responsibilities Performance & Reporting Own the monthly reporting cycle: volumes, net sales, gross margin, A&P and overheads — ensuring accuracy, consistency and on-time delivery to senior stakeholders Build and maintain robust dashboards and financial models that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for the business Lead variance analysis (actual vs. budget vs. forecast) and proactively identify risks and opportunities, with a clear point of view on drivers and recommendations Ensure data integrity across reporting tools and challenge figures when something doesn't add up Forecasting & Planning Lead closing activities and trend analysis, coordinating with multiple finance and business teams to deliver reliable landing estimates Drive the Strat Plan and AOP processes for your scope — not just consolidating numbers, but challenging assumptions, stress-testing scenarios and ensuring alignment with business priorities Anticipate financial risks and flag them early, with mitigation proposals ready Business Partnering Act as a true finance business partner to Marketing, Sales and Operations — embedded in the business, not just reporting to it Lead pricing and trade strategy analysis, providing financial guidance that directly informs commercial decision-making Independently build and present business cases to senior management, from framing the problem to the financial recommendation Influence decision-making at a senior level by combining financial rigor with strong business acumen Our employer commitments: The guarantee of a relevant, competitive and scalable compensation package, through external benchmark and internal equity. It consists among other things of a fixed salary, an yearly bonus, gain sharing. Flexibility of work and workplaces, such as weekly homeworking. Skills development for all, thanks to our Danone Academy France and through a year-round managerial conversation cycle. The possibility to use up to 3 days a year of volunteering through the platform Vendredi. Parenting policy benefits, such as extended Parental Leave (14 additional maternity/paternity days covered), or the ability to convert some earnings into time off Other benefits include a complementary pension scheme, health care plan, CSE, 100% of the Navigo pass covered (if Paris) About You The criteria below remain indicative. A candidate with a different combination of experience and skills could also be considered. Master's degree in Finance, Business or a related field Minimum 6 years' experience in Finance or Consulting Previous experience in a large international company is highly valued Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel; knowledge of Power BI is a plus Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment Organized, rigorous, proactive and a strong team player Fluent in English We are proud to promote diversity and equal opportunities within our teams. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and that an inclusive work environment supports our growth as a company, as teams, and as individuals. We therefore welcome all applications* while fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can feel they belong. We have also chosen to remove inclusive writing from our job descriptions, as its complexity can create barriers for individuals with cognitive disabilities, including dyslexia, dysphasia or apraxia. *All applications will be considered regardless of origin, background, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic. Every day, you will make decisions that impact our economic and societal performance, as well as our ability to achieve our ambitions. At Danone, you can just be yourself. We are convinced that it is up to YOU to define how you work, develop and progress. With us, you will work in a challenging, authentic, and caring environment. data.title: Mission - Technicien Systèmes (H/F)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Danone France ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais meilleure pour le monde ! C'est pour cela que nos 26 marques en France sont certifiées B Corp TM. B Corp est la boussole de notre stratégie RSE ! Cette certification permet de nous remettre en question afin de progresser continuellement et mesurer notre performance sociale et environnementale. Au sein de la Division Danone Specialized Nutrition, à proximité de Lille, l'usine de Steenvoorde est une usine clé fournissant des recettes complexes à hautes valeurs ajoutées. L'usine de Steenvoorde se trouve au début d'une transformation technologique et organisationnelle, pour répondre aux futurs marchés en termes de portefeuille de produits et aux exigences qualité et sécurité des aliments. Danone Steenvoorde c’est : Plus de 430 Danoners qui œuvrent chaque jour pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients en assurant la qualité des produits, la sécurité des femmes et des hommes et la réduction de notre impact sur l’environnement. Plus de 65 000 tonnes de produits sont fabriqués chaque année et exportés dans plus de 45 pays. Un portefeuille de 140 recettes pour nos jeunes consommateurs et nos patients exigeants. 4 lignes de conditionnement (3 sur le liquide et 1 sur la poudre), 1 tour de séchage et 1 atelier de filtration. Nous recherchons notre futur Danoner pour travailler dans notre super usine de Steenvoorde. Rattaché à l'équipe Conformité, Systèmes et performance Qualité, les principales missions sont : Traçabilité & conformité : Être le référent traçabilité du site, avec une forte implication et expertise sur l’ensemble des sujets impactant la traçabilité. Réaliser les exercices de traçabilité, analyser leurs résultats et évaluer leur efficacité. Contribuer à l’amélioration continue du niveau de maîtrise de la traçabilité Systèmes & outils : Améliorer la maîtrise des systèmes ( ERP, LIMS, …), Investigation des incohérences systèmes, Analyse des causes racines, proposition et mise en œuvre d’actions correctives. Construire et piloter une feuille de route systèmes Déployer de nouveaux outils transversaux dans le cadre de projets site ou groupe Contribuer à l’amélioration ou à l’optimisation des outils qualité existants Support qualité & opérations Suivre les envois sous quarantaine en lien avec les différents clients Assurer le backup sur les activités de libération Apporter un support opérationnel au service Qualité, participer activement à l’amélioration de la performance globale du service Qualité A PROPOS DE VOUS Les compétences requises : Excellente compréhension et maîtrise des interactions systèmes, avec capacité à expliquer les causes des incohérences Force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et amélioration continue Autonomie, dynamisme et capacité à avancer par soi-même Approche pragmatique, avec évaluation des risques Food Safety Capacité à travailler en transverse et à accompagner le changement Nous sommes fiers de promouvoir la diversité et l’égalité des chances au sein de nos équipes. data.description: About The Job For over 100 years, Danone has been supporting people worldwide with its 146 delicious brands. Located in over 120 countries with more than 89,000 employees across production sites, warehouses, headquarters, and R&D centers, Danone continually develops iconic products. B Corp certified, Danone France does not seek to be the best company in the world, but better for the world! This certification allows us to challenge ourselves in order to continuously improve and measure our social and environmental performance. Project Coordination: You will collaborate with Finance, IT, and Data teams to track project progress, ensure alignment, and support the preparation and organization of key deliverables. 2. Process Improvement & Automation: You will help identify opportunities to simplify manual activities through automation, participate in workflow testing, and assist in validating and documenting process improvements. 3. Reporting & Dashboard Support (Power BI): You will contribute to updating and enhancing dashboards, checking data accuracy and consistency, and proposing improvements to make reports more intuitive. 4. User Support: You will respond to user questions related to the project or tools and help facilitate training sessions or demonstrations. 5. Communication & Change Support: You will support the creation of clear and engaging communication materials, help distribute project updates across internal channels, and contribute to maintaining and improving the Connect SharePoint site. 6. Innovation & Digital Exploration: You will take part in testing innovative solutions—including AI features—and propose ideas that enhance user experience and overall efficiency. data.title: STAGE – R&I Product Intern – Septembre - (H/F)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans !  Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens.  Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs.   TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE:   Ce stage se déroulera au sein de notre centre R&I à Gif-sur-Yvette, à partir de septembre. Vous serez accompagné par Vincent LETELLIER, Chef de Produit R&I au sein de l’équipe IDDC Desserts, qui vous guidera dans vos missions quotidiennes et vous aidera à développer vos compétences. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Gérer des lots de projet liés au développement produit, en utilisant des outils de gestion de projet (planification, budgétisation, analyse des risques), de manière autonome ou avec le soutien d’un ingénieur. Concevoir des plans d’essais et assurer le suivi analytique, incluant l’analyse des données et des produits. Apporter un support technique pour le développement pilote et l’industrialisation des projets d’innovation ou de rénovation (élaborer des recettes théoriques, préparer et réaliser des essais en laboratoire, pilote et/ou industriel). Soutenir l’équipe dans la préparation d’études sensorielles et/ou consommateurs. Synthétiser les résultats et formuler des recommandations pour le lancement des produits. LES + DE CE STAGE:   Jusqu’à 2 jours/sem de télétravail  Prise en charge intégrale de ton abonnement de transport en région parisienne/lyonnaise ou remboursement partiel/intégral de tes frais kilométriques sur nos sites de production.
